text: まえより　いい　なまえ　じゃないか　よかったな！

structure.jp: まえより　いい　なまえ　じゃないか
structure.en: isn't it a better name than before

patterns.name: 〜より
patterns.explanation: より after a thing means 'than' that thing. まえより　いい = 'better than before'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.span: なまえ　じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃないか at the end does not deny anything; it says 'isn't it!' and expects you to agree. なまえ　じゃないか = 'it's a name, isn't it!'.
